name: s8_naming_lora
title: Naming costs the reward nothing and is right where the state is readable, but does not generalise
caption: A 400-step supervised adapter (continuing the NLA's RL LoRA) trained to append one true statement of the row's state; control arm = same explanations without the statement. 'Names' = the readout contains the filled statement template (string match, no judge). Left: naming arm on held-out source files (32 items per row); base and control name nothing on any row. 'right' = correct among named, Wilson 95% intervals wide at these n (e.g. 15/19: 0.57-0.91). Top right: gate reconstruction (FVE) on 192 held-out items (single file values; naming minus control per-item paired difference -0.003, bootstrap 95% [-0.019, +0.013]); dashed line = pre-registered target 0.761. Bottom right: exp 23's 500 random read points, recounted from the saved readouts; the adapter names 'outside' about as often whatever the truth.
